title: Mitchell 2024 TTX · Counterair sweep
subtitle: Figure 4 approach axes; Figure 5 between-pulse pressure
description: Source-based reenactment of the published 2024 Mitchell Institute TTX sweep team concept: three notional expendable CCA axes ahead of maritime strike pulses, followed on one axis by F-22/F-35, and recoverable CCA with F-15EX between pulses.
assumptions: Based on Mitchell Institute 2024 TTX conceptual proposals, not observed combat or verified flight plans.

The report specifies three approach axes and an air-to-air/EW CCA ratio of 3:1, but does not publish georeferenced waypoints or aircraft-specific tracks. Displayed routes are editorial, not reconstructed operational paths.
The report describes a two-strike-pulse-per-day planning assumption; playback seconds are not operational hours.
Illustrated aircraft and CCA symbols represent source-described roles, not verified inventories at particular coordinates.
